notes: Board versions changed over production, so chip entries may not match every UV-5R.

gaps: No service manual or parts list found.
Reference oscillator conflict: hamskey says the RDA1846 has a 24 MHz oscillator, the RadioReference wiki says these radios have a 26 MHz reference oscillator, so no crystal is claimed.
That manual prints no model name and is tied to the UV-5R only by the Archive item title.
Fccid.io lists ZP5BF-5R (Fujian Nan'an Baofeng, model BF-5R, granted 2012-05-21, 1.3 W at 136-174 MHz, 1.78 W at 400-480 MHz) but does not name the UV-5R, so no FCC ID is set.
method: Hamskey.com (KD8CEC, 18 Dec 2017) names the MCU MB95F013K and the RF chip RDA1846 (marked 1846) on its unit, with no board version or year given.
Elazary.com (Lior Elazary KK6BWA, Feb-Mar 2013) interfaced with the RDA5802 FM radio receiver chip (the article's index also has an RDA1846 page).
A 2020 1bitsquared forum teardown (esden) found a chip-on-board (COB) under the LCD without identifying it.
The RadioReference wiki names the AT1846S as the transceiver chip of UV-5R/UV-82 type radios.

Ratings: the Chinese Radio Documentation Project guide (Lennart Lidberg, 2012, CC BY-SA 3.0; Internet Archive) gives supply voltage 7.4, 4 W / 1 W and 1000 mW audio (appendix C, PDF pp.69-70), the SMA connectors and box contents (PDF p.11), charging (p.12) and the speaker and microphone (p.15).
A scanned English user manual on the Internet Archive gives the rechargeable Li-ion 7.4 V / 1800 mAh battery (spec table, PDF p.18).
Its cover reads VHF/UHF FM Transceiver, and Baofeng is named in the safety text.
Its spec table matches the guide's appendix C apart from the weight.
Its exhibits, fcc.report and apps.fcc.gov returned bot checks or access denied, and the All About Circuits teardown is behind a Cloudflare check.

comps.spec: Dual-band handheld, 136-174 and 400-480 MHz Tx/Rx (65-108 MHz FM broadcast Rx only), RF power 4 W high / 1 W low, supply voltage 7.4
RF controller chip RDA1846 (marked 1846), covers VHF and UHF
Male SMA antenna connector on the radio
Antenna supplied in the box, female SMA connector
Desk charger with plug-in wall adapter, supplied in the box; red LED while charging, green when full
Speaker and microphone on the radio body; receiver audio output 1000 mW
